avoid_supplements.name: Phosphate supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Lanthanum binds phosphate in GI tract; phosphate supplementation counteracts therapeutic effect and increases hyperphosphatemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue phosphate supplements; monitor serum phosphate levels regularly

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both lanthanum and calcium bind phosphate; concurrent use may lead to hypophosphatemia and reduced bioavailability of other nutrients
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours; use lowest effective calcium dose

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Lanthanum may bind iron in GI tract, reducing iron absorption and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Administer iron supplement 2+ hours apart from lanthanum; monitor for anemia

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Lanthanum may slightly reduce magnesium absorption if taken concurrently
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum magnesium levels; separate dosing by 2+ hours if possible

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May affect calcium and phosphate metabolism balance; lanthanum patients often require coordinated vitamin D therapy
caution_supplements.action: Coordinate with prescriber; monitor calcium and phosphate levels

avoid_foods.name: High-phosphate foods (processed meats, dairy, nuts, seeds)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Lanthanum efficacy depends on dietary phosphate restriction; high-phosphate foods reduce treatment effectiveness
avoid_foods.action: Educate patient on phosphate-restricted diet; work with renal dietitian for meal planning

avoid_foods.name: Foods with added phosphate additives
avoid_foods.mechanism: Food additives (phosphates in processed foods, colas, baked goods) significantly increase dietary phosphate burden
avoid_foods.action: Read labels; avoid processed foods, soft drinks, and commercially prepared items with phosphate additives

caution_foods.name: Calcium-rich foods (milk, cheese, yogurt)
caution_foods.mechanism: High concurrent calcium intake may interfere with lanthanum absorption or alter phosphate-calcium balance
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation as part of balanced renal diet; coordinate timing with lanthanum doses

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum phosphate, calcium, and magnesium levels regularly to assess efficacy and prevent mineral imbalances. Patient adherence to low-phosphate diet is critical for lanthanum effectiveness in chronic kidney disease management.
